entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2 20-01-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.P.P. for the State.
The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Phulwari Sharif P.S. Case No. 187 of 2015 registered under Sections 498A/ 494 of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that petitioner is on Police Bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, it appears that the matter is well covered by the decision of this Court in the case of Mahendra Prasad Singh Vs. State of Bihar, reported in 2004(3)
P.L.J.R., 491.

entities.text:
Mahendra Prasad Singh Vs. State of Bihar, reported in 2004(3)
P.L.J.R., 491
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, it is directed that petitioner may Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.67275 of 2022(2) dt.20-01-2023 surrender before the Court below within a period of four weeks from today.

In case, petitioner surrenders and files an application for bail, the concerned Court will pass an order in the similar manner as has been decided in the case of Mahendra Prasad Singh (Supra).
